title: The world's heights and sea floor for Capo's relief map, with ice
maker: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information; Natural Earth

title: The larger rivers and lakes for Capo's map

title: What grows on the land, for Capo's map: forest, grassland, desert, tundra and marsh

changes: the 14 biomes, and rock and ice, rasterised onto the map's Miller projection at 2048 by 1500; the coast's gaps filled from the nearest biome, specks voted away, the open sea cleared; saved as lossless WebP by tools/mapdata.py

title: Real cities for Capo's map
source: Natural Earth 1:10m populated places, simple, version 5.1.2 (naturalearthdata.com); no credit is needed, given as a courtesy
changes: capitals, cities of 1.5 million people or more and world cities, and others of 300,000 or more; projected onto the map's Miller projection, snapped onto the provinces' land, ranked, and tagged with the province each falls in, by tools/mapdata.py
